summary_claims.claim: 6 years' imprisonment, applies to altered/AI-created material
aggravated offence 7 years where responsible for creation or 3+ civil penalty orders

scope.note: Not AI-specific, but the operative criminal offence for AI-generated deepfake sexual material; fits the precedent for non-AI-specific laws that are the operative instrument for an AI-safety question.
